opening: I've been feeling sick to my stomach.
I've been unsteady on my feet when I walk.
All of this started 10 days ago.
It's so bad that I can't stand up without help.

opening.text: I've been feeling sick to my stomach, and my speech has become slurred. I've been unsteady on my feet when I walk; it's so bad that I can't stand up without help. All of this started 10 days ago.
